messages:
aanand: Alert: sudden spike in 429s from API consumers, many customers reporting throttling even under normal usage. Observed across hosted and dedicated ingress.
mei: Looking at rate-limiter metrics. There's a surge in per-key rejection counts after the config deploy at 07:10 UTC.
carlos: Confirmed: global rate-limiter now applies the strict burst window (was meant for internal-only keys). I think the policy flag rolled out unexpectedly.
aanand: Paging oncall and create incident.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-5788 created and assigned to infra-oncall. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-5788
mei: Temporary mitigation: disable strict burst enforcement globally and fall back to previous per-key token bucket. Applying flag: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/flags -d '{"flag":"rl.strict_burst","value":false}'
ratebot: Rate-limiter config rollback applied: rl.strict_burst=false. Rejected request rate reduced by ~85%.
cs-rep: CS notifying impacted customers and adding guidance: "If you see 429s, retry with exponential backoff; we are rolling out mitigation now."
mei: Root cause: deploy included a change that enabled the stricter burst window for production by mistake. Missing deploy-time guard in rollout pipeline.
carlos: Hotfix: add deploy-time check to prevent internal flags from being enabled in prod, and revert the change in the config repo. Patching now.
status-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/PD-5788 - "Rate limiting misconfiguration causing 429s; mitigations in progress"
aanand: Metrics look good: 429s dropped back to baseline within 6 minutes after flag flip. Keeping monitor for 30m.
mei: Action items: 1) add automated deploy guard + unit tests for flag scoping 2) add canary that exercises rate-limiter with real API keys 3) add customer-visible header to 429s explaining reason and retry-after suggestion.
carlos: Filing tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8155, INF-8156, INF-8157
oncall-bot: Incident PD-5788 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring
aanand: Thanks everyone. Postmortem draft expected in ~3h; will include affected customer list and timeline."
